observation.visible_scene: A wide, static view of an alpine lake (glacier-fed) on a clear day. A snow-covered glacier and rock face fill the center background, flanked by a steep forested cliff and pine slope on the left and a tree-covered mountain slope on the right. The left foreground shows a pale rocky shoreline with scattered boulders; the right foreground is shallow, clear water over rounded submerged stones. Far out on the right side of the lake sit a few small red canoes/kayaks with people. The lower-center water carries a bright white reflection of the sky and glacier.
visible_changes: The lake surface in the foreground continuously ripples: the bright white sky/glacier reflection in the lower-center deforms, shifts and breaks into moving horizontal shimmer bands from frame to frame.
The clear shallow water over the submerged stones on the right shows subtle, ongoing surface distortion/shimmer as ripples pass.
The distant red canoes remain at essentially the same positions along the right horizon across the excerpt, with no clearly resolvable translation.
The mountains, glacier, forested slopes, shoreline and boulders stay fixed in place; the framing is constant, indicating no camera pan/zoom.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the canoes drift or paddle at any point (their motion, if any, is below the resolution of this segment).
The wind or current that drives the surface ripples.
What happens before or after this cropped interval.
uncertain_details: Any very small movement of the canoes cannot be confirmed against the static background.
Whether there is any sub-pixel camera jitter is indeterminate; the scene reads as a locked-off shot.
